name.ja: 3平面波の非局所projectorと有限温度占有
name.en: A three-wave periodic projector and Fermi-occupation model

caption.ja: 3平面波の小周期模型で、非局所projectorと有限温度占有・力を示します。 自作3平面波の線形Hamiltonianです。平均占有の独立粒子Fermi模型であり、整数粒子の正準多体系ではありません。自己無撞着Hartree/XC、元素適合ノルム保存擬ポテンシャル、実金属、一般材料、長時間MDは未検証。
caption.en: Show a genuine rank-one nonlocal kernel and finite-temperature occupations in a three-wave periodic educational model. Authored linear3-wave Hamiltonian with independent-particle mean Fermi occupations, not an integer-particle canonical many-body ensemble. No self-consistent Hartree/XC, element-fitted norm-conserving PSP, real metal, general material or longMD validation.

name.en: Three-wave nonlocal kernel and mean Fermi occupations

equation_note.ja: G=-1,0,1、k=±0.25、等重み、T=.05、電子数1.5の自作線形模型です。 無次元のG=-1,0,1、p=G+k、k=±.25、重み各.5、T=.05、平均電子数N=1.5、スピン係数2。実在格子定数や金属へ換算しません。
equation_note.en: Authored rank-one periodic linear model and finite-N Helmholtz forces. No real metal/element pseudopotential/norm conservation/Hartree-XC/long MD claim. N=1.5 is a mean independent-particle Fermi occupation count, not an integer-N canonical many-body ensemble. Dimensionless G=-1,0,1,p=G+k,k=±.25 with equal.5weights,T=.05,mean electron countN=1.5 and spin factor2. No physical lattice-constant or metal mapping.
